title: Input rule payload
description: Pre-execution job-side input policy. Match selects which content the rule applies to; decide chooses the unified DecisionType. Aligns with safetykernel input scanners.

type.description: Discriminator for a Rule's match/decide payload schema.

scope.description:
Narrows where a rule (or bundle) applies. When `kind` is `global`,
`value` is unused and may be empty; for the other kinds, `value`
carries the corresponding identifier (tenant id, workflow id, edge
fleet name, edge user id).

status.description:
Lifecycle state of a Rule. `draft` rules are author-only; `published`
rules participate in evaluation; `deprecated` rules remain queryable
for audit and rollback but are skipped by evaluators.

audit.description:
Records who created or last updated a Rule or Bundle. The `updated_*`
fields are zero-valued on first creation and populated by the first
subsequent edit. `pack_source` is populated when the rule
originated from a `cordumctl pack install` YAML bundle (Backend
5d) — the dashboard's pack_id + tier columns + Source filter
depend on it surfacing on every legacy-bundle-loaded rule.

pack_source.description:
Pack-level provenance for rules loaded from cordumctl pack
bundles. Mirrors `policybundles.PolicyRuleSource` field-for-field
so legacy → unified translation is lossless. RuleStore-authored
rules (created via Dashboard 3E publish-to-bundle) leave the
whole sub-field unset.

firing_last_7d.description:
7-bucket daily firing histogram (oldest→newest) for the rule scoped
to the request tenant. Populated by `GET /api/v1/policy/rules` via
a single bulk job-history scan per request. Absent (omitted) when
firing analytics are not computed for the request — e.g. tenant-less
calls, individual single-rule GET endpoints, or jobStore unavailable.

risk_tags.description: Required risk tags on the job context for the rule to fire.

content_pattern.description: Optional regex applied to the input content; rule fires only when content matches.

reason.description: Human-readable rationale logged with the decision.
